title: hydrangea paniculata f. velutina
intro: Hydrangea paniculata f. velutina, commonly known as Velvet Leaf Hydrangea, is a deciduous shrub native to mountainous regions in East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Velvet Leaf Hydrangea include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable remedy for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
